title: Gargi Flow Graph Definition
description: Version 1 Graph Definition Schema for Gargi Flow

apiVersion.description: API Version for the graph schema definition

id.description: The unique identifier of the graph definition

name.description: Human-readable name of the graph definition

description.description: A longer description of the graph definition

nodes.description: A list of nodes making up the graph. At least one is required.

edges.description: A list of directed edges representing paths between nodes.

retryPolicies.description: A map of retry policies reusable by nodes.

compensations.description: A map of compensation handlers reusable by nodes.

id.description: The unique identifier of the node

type.description: The type of the node. Must map to an engine registry type.

config.description: Free-form configuration specific to the node's type. Checked at runtime by the specific node implementation.

joinMode.description: Fan-in join mode for incoming edges. Default is all_of.

retryPolicy.description: Reference to a retry policy defined in retryPolicies.

startToCloseTimeoutMs.description: Optional per-node StartToClose timeout in milliseconds.

scheduleToCloseTimeoutMs.description: Optional per-node ScheduleToClose timeout in milliseconds.

compensation.description: Reference to a compensation defined in compensations.

from.description: The origin node of the edge.

to.description: The destination node of the edge.

condition.description: An opaque expression. Conditions are not evaluated or validated yet. Absent condition means 'always'.

dataMapping.description: Data mapping between the outgoing output and the incoming input variables.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of execution attempts. 1 means no retry. Default is 1.

initialIntervalMs.description: Initial interval between retry attempts in milliseconds.

backoffCoefficient.description: The coefficient to multiply the backoff by after each failure. Default is 2.

maxIntervalMs.description: The maximum interval for any given backoff iteration.

type.description: The specific type of compensation handler.

config.description: Free-form object containing specifics for the compensation handler type.

FailurePolicy.description: Defines behavior around critical and retryable failures.

onNodeFailure.description: What happens after a node fails with a non-retryable error or exhausts retries. Default is fail_graph.

onCriticalFailure.description: What happens after a node fails with a critical error. Default is compensate.
